headline: Philippine Trade-in-Goods Deficit Widens to Record $6.95B in October
summary: The Philippines trade-in-goods deficit widened to a record $6.95 billion in October as both exports and imports shifted.
why: Trade deficits affect current account balances, foreign exchange reserves, and domestic currency valuations for emerging economies.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: A wider trade deficit places downward pressure on the local currency and current account stability.
